description: This file defines a Pinia store for managing exercise entries in a Vue.js application. It includes state management for exercise items, loading status, and error message, along with functions to fetch all exercises and add a new exercise.

methods.name: fetchAll
methods.description: Fetches all exercise entries from API and updates the store state.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new exercise entry via API and updates the store with the new entry.
